summary.text: Hearcel Craig represents Ohio's 15th Senate District and serves as Assistant Minority Leader. He was elected to the Senate in 2018 and 2022 after serving in the Ohio House and on Columbus City Council.

paragraphs.text: Craig graduated from Columbus East High School and earned a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from Franklin University, after also attending The Ohio State University and Gospel Lighthouse School of Ministry.
He later earned a Master of Science in Administration from Central Michigan University and served in the United States Army from 1970 to 1972.
His public service career began as a legislative liaison for the Ohio Department of Youth Services, after which he served as Director of Recruitment & Admissions for City Year.
On Columbus City Council he was named President Pro Tempore and chaired committees including Public Service & Transportation, Health & Human Services, and Veterans' Affairs.
He was also Executive Director of the Hilltop Civic Council and an Auto Policy Issue Manager at JC Penney Casualty Insurance Co.

In the General Assembly, Craig was credited with the 2021 legislation making Juneteenth a paid state holiday and was instrumental in passing Senate Bill 31, which designated Poindexter Village as a historic state site.
He is Ranking Member of the Senate committees on Financial Institutions, Insurance, and Technology, on Housing, and on Small Business and Economic Opportunity.
Craig and his wife, Linda, are the parents of four children, and he serves as an Associate Minister at the First Church of God.
